Cathlyn is an anime writer with years of experience covering some of the biggest and most popular series of all time. She loves writing listicles, features, and query-based articles about all things related to anime. Outside of writing, she enjoys playing mobile games, building Lego and Nanoblock sets, playing pickleball, watching movies, and rewatching her favorite anime series. Before joining GameRant as a contributor, she worked in Epicstream’s anime department. Beyond her passion for anime, she also enjoys writing romance fiction, with her most successful work surpassing one million reads on Wattpad.
In the present era of Boruto , plenty of familiar characters from the original Naruto series have become fathers to the next generation of shinobi. They are now doing their best to raise their children with their partners while fulfilling their duties as responsible ninjas to their respective hidden villages.
Times may have changed, but that doesn't mean the strongest fathers in Boruto have weakened. They remain among the most powerful shinobi in the world, equipped with advanced ninjutsu, kekkei genkai, dojutsu, and other unique abilities that make them formidable opponents even in the new era.
8 Sai Yamanaka Has Become an Important Anbu Leader in Konoha
Sai Yamanaka, Inojin’s father, is the Anbu's dedicated chief and actively fights on the battlefield under the Hokage’s orders. Beyond his combat duties, Sai helps maintain peace and order in Konoha, ensuring the Leaf Village remains protected from internal and external threats.
In Boruto , Sai is often seen investigating suspicious activities and potential threats to the hidden village. His experience as a former Root operative, combined with his analytical skills and mastery of the Super Beast Scroll technique, makes him a valuable asset to Konoha’s intelligence and security operations.
7 Choji Akimichi Is One of Konoha's Most Dependable Veteran Shinobi
Of all the fathers in Boruto , Choji Akimichi shares one of the closest bonds with his daughter , Chocho, who hilariously once questioned whether he was her biological father. The two share a love for food, often spending quality time together trying different dishes, snacks, and desserts. Their shared passion for eating brings them close to each other.
Although Choji doesn't receive much screen time in Boruto , he remains a valuable shinobi who has supported Naruto and Konoha for years. With his Akimichi clan techniques and ability to expand his body to immense proportions, Choji remains a capable fighter who can hold his own in battle and protect his village in times of need.
6 Shikamaru Nara Is Holding Konoha Together in Naruto's Absence
At present, Shikamaru Nara serves as Konoha's interim Hokage , refusing to officially assume the title of Eighth Hokage while Naruto remains missing. He has plenty of responsibilities to juggle, from meeting the Fire Daimyo's demands and dealing with Jura, the leader of the Shinju Clones, to secretly cooperating with the rogue ninja Boruto Uzumaki and his ally, Kashin Koji.
Although Shikamaru spends much of his time in the Hokage's office, his mind is constantly occupied with the challenges threatening Konoha. Despite his administrative responsibilities, he remains a skilled shinobi on the battlefield, wielding advanced Nara clan shadow techniques that can restrain even powerful opponents such as Momoshiki and Kinshiki, if only temporarily.
5 Orochimaru Is Still a Major Threat Despite His Quiet Life
Orochimaru artificially created Mitsuki, a competent member of Team 7 who considers Boruto Uzumaki his sun and follows him with unwavering loyalty until Eida's Omnipotence turns his world upside down. As Mitsuki's creator and father figure in Boruto , Orochimaru continues to observe his son's development while allowing him to forge his own path as a shinobi.
Although Orochimaru chooses to maintain a low profile in Boruto , that doesn't mean he has grown weaker. He remains a dangerous shinobi who can unleash forbidden jutsu, summon powerful creatures, and regenerate from fatal injuries. As one of the legendary Sannin, Orochimaru remains a top-tier ninja.
4 Rock Lee Is Too Powerful to Be Sidelined in Boruto
Rock Lee remains one of Konoha's most formidable adult shinobi. As Metal Lee's father, he continues to stand out for his exceptional taijutsu. More impressively, his ability to unlock all Eight Inner Gates grants him tremendous physical strength and speed worthy of a top-tier shinobi, allowing him to continue pursuing his lifelong goal of surpassing his mentor, Might Guy.
Unfortunately, Boruto hasn't treated Rock Lee as kindly as some of his former comrades, often leaving the taijutsu specialist on the sidelines despite his incredible combat potential. Even when powerful enemies threaten Konoha, Rock Lee receives little to no screen time, leaving fans wondering why one of the village's strongest fighters rarely gets the chance to show off.
3 Gaara Is Still a Respected Kage Who Can Stand Against Godlike Enemies
The Hidden Sand Village has a competent Kage in Gaara, who once saw the shinobi world and its people as nothing more than enemies to be eliminated. In the past, he believed that his only purpose in life was to kill others. Fortunately, Gaara has long since changed his ways and now dedicates himself to protecting his village and nurturing the next generation of shinobi, including the children under his care.
Although Gaara no longer has access to Shukaku and the massive chakra reserves that came with the One-Tail, he remains a formidable Kage on the battlefield. His mastery of sand manipulation and Magnet Release kekkei genkai allows him to hold his own against increasingly powerful opponents, including Kinshiki, Momoshiki, and even the Shinju Clones.
2 Naruto's Sage Mode Keeps Him Dangerous After Losing Kurama
Naruto Uzumaki isn't just Boruto and Himawari's father, as the Seventh Hokage also sees himself as the father of Konoha, protecting the village as he sees fit. He may not be the best father in Boruto , but he always tries his best to fulfill his responsibilities to his real family and to his extended family.
Now that Naruto is an adult ninja, his skills are more refined and advanced. He is no longer as impulsive as he once was, but when the village is attacked, he never hesitates to risk his life. Losing Kurama may have revoked his access to many of his abilities and transformations, but Naruto remains a seasoned shinobi with immense chakra reserves, battle experience, and Sage Mode to fight enemies.
1 Sasuke Remains a Powerful Defender of Konoha Despite His Losses
As the Shadow Hokage, Sasuke Uchiha is often away on missions, investigating suspicious activities that threaten the shinobi world, particularly Konoha. This leaves Sakura to raise Sarada largely on her own, while Sasuke continues his duties from behind the scenes to protect the hidden village from potential threats.
On the battlefield, Sasuke is equipped with his signature dojutsu, Sharingan, and its evolved form, Mangekyo Sharingan. He still has access to his iconic abilities, such as the Susanoo, which provides him with powerful offensive and defensive abilities. He may have lost the Rinnegan in Boruto , but that doesn't mean he's any less dangerous.
